_meta.name: English (United States)
_meta.note: The source language. Copy this file to <tag>.json, translate the values, and place it in /etc/labkiosk/i18n on the data partition. Keys that are missing or empty fall back to the English in the page.

admin.prompt: Enter the administrator or boot password to configure network settings.
admin.promptLocale: Enter the administrator or boot password to change the date, time and language.
admin.title: Administrator Verification
locale.checkLanguages: Check the school server for more languages
locale.desc: Choose the language, region and clock for this workstation. These are applied now and carried onto the disk when you install.
locale.localeHint: Dates, numbers and the language websites are asked for. English (India) keeps English wording with Indian date and number formats.
locale.noLanguages: The school server offers no additional languages yet.
locale.ntpServerHint: Where this workstation asks for the time once it is online. Leave empty to use Debian's public pool; a school that blocks outbound NTP should name its own server here.
locale.syncTime: Set the clock automatically once the network is configured
locale.uiLanguageHint: The language of this wizard and of the kiosk bar. Additional languages are added by placing their catalog in /etc/labkiosk/i18n.
ui.configure-internet-connectivity-for-t: Configure internet connectivity for this workstation. Connect via wired Ethernet or wireless Wi-Fi before proceeding.
ui.enter-the-administrator-boot-menu-pas: Enter the administrator / boot menu password to unlock network settings.
ui.i-understand-continue-to-the-lesson: I understand — continue to the lesson
ui.install-lab-kiosk-to-selected-drive: Install Lab Kiosk to Selected Drive
ui.permanently-install-lab-kiosk-os-to: Permanently install Lab Kiosk OS to this computer's internal storage (SSD/HDD). The configured network will persist automatically.
ui.protects-the-boot-menu-and-is: Protects the boot menu and is required for any later network change on this machine. Without one, network settings stay unlocked.
ui.the-workstation-s-own-log-for: The workstation's own log, for when something fails here. It lives in RAM and is cleared on every reboot, so read it before restarting.
ui.this-workstation-cannot-remember-an-e: This workstation cannot remember an enrolment.
ui.this-workstation-lost-its-network-con: This workstation lost its network connection. It returns to the lesson automatically once the connection is back.
ui.warning-installing-will-completely-er: ⚠️ WARNING: Installing will completely erase and re-partition the selected drive.
